case_types.label: New flow
case_types.hint: Something the bot was never tested on: a new feature or a new kind of question.

case_types.label: Edge case
case_types.hint: A known flow that breaks in an unusual situation (missing data, odd wording, mixed language).

case_types.label: Wrong answer
case_types.hint: The bot answered wrongly, or said something it must never say (e.g. a medicine that is unsafe in this situation). Fix the answer above, or explain in the description what is wrong.

case_types.label: Good answer to keep
case_types.hint: The bot got it right and must keep getting it right.

tags.label: Veterinary advisory
tags.hint: Animal health, disease, treatment, heat, pregnancy.

tags.label: AIT booking
tags.hint: Booking an artificial insemination technician, and its status.

tags.label: Milk collection
tags.hint: Farmer's milk pouring records, fat/SNF, quantities.

tags.label: Milk earnings & bonus
tags.hint: Payments, earnings, bonus calculation.

tags.label: Union schemes
tags.hint: Schemes of the farmer's milk union (e.g. a specific district union), what its circulars offer, and their helpline numbers. A scheme question that doesn't name the government goes here.

tags.label: Government schemes
tags.hint: State and central government schemes and subsidies, and their helpline numbers.

tags.label: Feed & nutrition
tags.hint: Cattle feed, fodder, mineral mixture.

tags.label: Weather
tags.hint: Forecasts and weather-based advice.

tags.label: Market prices (APMC)
tags.hint: Mandi / APMC prices for crops.

tags.label: Crop advisory
tags.hint: Farming, crops, soil, pests.

tags.label: Farmer profile & sign-in
tags.hint: Farmer ID, society, account details.

tags.label: Animal records
tags.hint: The farmer's animals and their health and visit records, CVCC history included.

tags.label: Cattle trade
tags.hint: Cattle rates, buying and selling animals.

tags.label: Soil health card
tags.hint: The farmer's soil health card and what it says.

tags.label: Micro-loan
tags.hint: Micro-loan eligibility and loan codes.

tags.label: Nearest vet office
tags.hint: Finding the nearest government veterinary office.

tags.label: PM-KISAN status
tags.hint: The farmer's PM-KISAN registration and installment status.

tags.label: Follow-up question
tags.hint: A question that depends on what was said earlier in the chat.

tags.label: Suggested questions
tags.hint: The follow-up questions the bot suggests after an answer.

tags.label: Safety
tags.hint: Moderation declines, abuse, prompt injection, personal data in a question, vet drug and dose rules.

tags.label: General / other
tags.hint: Greetings, small talk, out-of-scope questions, and anything that fits no other feature.

answer_types.label: Sends to a vet
answer_types.hint: the main advice is to get a vet to see the animal, as for fever, bloat, swelling, a retained placenta or repeat breeding, with or without the bot's own advice. Care, feed and dose questions are answer, and so is "see a vet if it gets worse"

answer_types.label: Says it can't
answer_types.hint: it says it can't do this here, or has no data for it

answer_types.label: Declines
answer_types.hint: it declines a question it shouldn't answer, like an off-topic one or one about another farmer's data
